name: next-up
description: When a turn ends, suggests up to three next prompts from the conversation, your open GitHub issues and pull requests, or your Linear issues.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Where the steps come from: "conversation" (default) continues the current work and reads no source; "linear" only suggests your open Linear issues; "github" only suggests open GitHub issues and pull requests. "/next mode <name>" changes it for the session.

linearProject.title: Linear project
linearProject.description: Only issues in this Linear project (name, identifier or slug). Empty (default): all your open issues.
